Sharper upscaling (Qualcomm SGSR)\nThe game is drawn smaller than the screen and enlarged; SGSR keeps edges sharp where plain enlarging blurs them
Compare upscaling (diagnostic)\nSGSR on and off every 3 seconds, with a label
Lower the resolution when the game slows down\nUnder 27 fps the game is drawn smaller a step at a time, down to 70% of the render resolution, only while each step helps; the upscaling enlarges it
Lobby bridge\nThe app stands in for BAR\'s PC launcher, for the Replays tab, web links and skill ratings; the lobby\'s downloads go through the app. Off: the Replays tab cannot list replays
BAR touch controls\nDrag pans, pinch zooms, twist rotates, two fingers up or down tilt, tap then drag selects, long press gives orders. Off: the touch modes under Display

Play upright (portrait)\nThe lobby and the game upright: the game on top, a touch dock below. The dock is a camera pad: hold and drag pans, double tap and hold zooms (up or down) or turns (sideways), triple tap and hold tilts. A tap opens its menu until it is left 2 s: build, orders, groups, the commander and base (a drag on its empty space pans); then a drag on the game draws the picked units\' path, or selects. A tap on metal or energy opens their sliders
Keyboard shortcuts go to the game\nAlt+Tab, the Windows key, Ctrl+Space and the soft keyboard\'s language switch reach BAR while it is in front, not Android, One UI or DeX. Off: Android\'s own
Beyond All Reason keyboard shortcuts

Optional. Sends the keyboard shortcuts Android would take for itself (Alt+Tab, the Windows key, Ctrl+Space) to Beyond All Reason while its game screen is in front. Needed only where Android does not hand them to the game by itself (before Android 16.1). It reads keys only while the game screen has focus and passes them to the game; Home, Recents, power and volume keys stay Android\'s.
proot: disable seccomp acceleration\nEvery system call of the game stops in proot: much slower; only to test whether its filter breaks something (PROOT_NO_SECCOMP)
Verbose X server logging\nThe display server\'s (Termux:X11) debug output in the log
